UserFund.title: UserFund
UserFund.description: Configuration for a private family contribution fund owned by an authenticated username/password user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the fund owner.

username.description: Account username displayed in the app.

fundName.description: Display name of the family fund.

reminderTemplate.description: Customizable WhatsApp payment reminder message template.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the fund was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the fund settings were last updated.

FamilyMember.title: FamilyMember
FamilyMember.description: A family member participating in the monthly contribution fund with a pre-allocated monthly amount in BHD.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the fund owner.

name.description: Full name of the family member.

phone.description: WhatsApp phone number with optional country code.

monthlyAmount.description: Pre-allocated monthly contribution amount in BHD (non-negative, up to 1,000,000).

startMonth.description: Starting month key in YYYY-MM format.

isActive.description: Whether the member is currently active for monthly billing.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the member record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the member record was last updated.

MonthlyPayment.title: MonthlyPayment
MonthlyPayment.description: A payment record for a specific family member in a specific calendar month (document ID: memberId_YYYY-MM).

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the fund owner.

memberId.description: Document ID of the associated FamilyMember.

monthKey.description: Calendar month key in YYYY-MM format.

expectedAmount.description: Expected monthly contribution snapshot in BHD.

paidDate.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) when payment was recorded, or empty string if unpaid.

note.description: Optional payment method or short remark.

lastRemindedAt.description: Optional server timestamp of last WhatsApp reminder sent.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the payment record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the payment record was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private family fund configuration document owned strictly by the authenticated user.

/users/{userId}/members/{memberId}.description: Family members belonging to the authenticated user's fund (PII strictly owner-isolated).

/users/{userId}/payments/{paymentId}.description: Monthly payment ledger records linked to members in the authenticated user's fund.
